AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: To determine whether superior hypogastric plexus block performed during abdominal hysterectomy decreases postoperative opioid consumption and pain.

AbstractText.Label: DESIGN
AbstractText.content: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, clinical trial.

AbstractText.Label: POPULATION
AbstractText.content: Sixty-eight women scheduled for total abdominal hysterectomy for a benign indication.

AbstractText.Label: METHODS
AbstractText.content: Twenty ml of ropivacaine 7.5 mg/ml or saline was injected retroperitoneally in the area of the superior hypogastric plexus during the hysterectomy. The participants were individually randomised to either intervention. The participants, caregivers, and those assessing the outcomes were blinded to group assignment.

AbstractText.Label: MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES
AbstractText.content: The primary outcomes were postoperative opiate consumption and patients' self-assessment of pain (VAS scores). Secondary outcomes were mobilisation and side effects related to opiate consumption.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The trial was completed with 38 women randomised to ropivacaine and 37 women randomised to saline. Analysis was performed on 35 women in the ropivaciane group and 33 women in the saline group. The postoperative opioid consumption was significantly lower in the ropivacaine group than in the placebo group (median 55.8 and 72.4 mg, respectively, P = 0.032). The proportion of women scoring VAS <4 at 2 hours after block was significantly higher in the ropivacaine group (63%) than in the placebo group (25%) (P = 0.015). No side effects or important adverse events occurred during the trial.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSIONS
AbstractText.content: The superior hypogastric plexus block is a new method in this context and a promising contribution to postoperative pain treatment after abdominal hysterectomy.

AbstractText.Label: TWEETABLE ABSTRACT
AbstractText.content: Superior hypogastric plexus block during abdominal hysterectomy lowers opioid consumption.
